broker_config.contact_ceiling_formula: not used in c3: contact_pool = 12 runs x 30 = 360; the broker's USD cap (max_usd minus other c3 ledgers, reservation per request) is the hard limit. floor(15 / reservation) = 74 contacts would be guaranteed even if every call cost the full reservation.
broker_config.model_note: Copied unchanged from bound-m-c2-260925. The c2 configs used one model (no separate reflection model), so every arm, GEPA reflection included, uses gemini-3.8-flash; gemini-3.1-pro-preview is not used. Re-verify the model id and prices against a live listing before use.
broker_config.note: Copied from autoresearch/bound-m-c2-260925/broker-config.json (gemini-3.8-flash, same prices, reasoning, timeout and stream fields) for bound-m campaign 3 with max_usd 15 (raised from the $10 brief after the $11-14 projection), max_tokens 16384 (the c3 seed is 21.8 KB against 9.4 KB in c2, where 32 of 342 calls already hit the 8192 cap), an explicit contact_pool of 360 and the fresh ledger prefix broker-ledger-bound-c3. Each (arm, seed) run has its own ledger broker-ledger-bound-c3.<arm>-s<seed>.json (none may exist before its first live run); its broker gets --max-requests = min(sub-cap 30, contact_pool minus contacts in the other c3 ledgers) and --max-usd = max_usd minus USD charged in the other c3 ledgers. Pending human approval (payload-approved.sha256); no live call is authorized.
broker_config.price_source: Copied unchanged from the applied broker-config.json.
broker_config.reasoning_effort_note: Copied unchanged from the applied broker-config.json.

controls.revtree_table_fed: integrations.bound3_control_revtree (trusted, in-process; exact tables; non-uniform reference, development m <= 10 only)

finalize.determinism: two sandboxed bound-eval-3 runs on the first 20 screen families; raw tree outputs compared per family
finalize.holdout: c2 frozen/holdout.json (165 m=12 + 60 m=11), evaluated once per frozen finalist by a human-run finalize; not built yet (REPORT-prep.md)
finalize.selection: per (arm, seed): among accepted candidates (seed, every source with a full development evaluation, the verified best, GEPA's candidate pool), the finalist maximizes validation (certified, combined_score); ties by source sha256 ascending. Development scores are not used.
finalize.success_rule: An arm succeeds iff (1) the mean over its 3 seed finalists of the certified share on the 165 m=12 holdout families is >= the c3 seed's m=12 share + 3 percentage points, AND (2) the mean over its finalists of the number certified among the 14 target families is >= 5. Target families: the m=12 holdout families not certified by any of AdaEvolve-s2, EvoX-s3, the c2 seed and control (b) (BEST-C2-CONSTRUCTION.md section 2), recomputed by finalize from the stored c2 holdout rows; finalize aborts unless there are exactly 14. Single-seed wins are reported, not claimed.

lines: Hint (group's m=8 proof, REVERSAL-OBSTACLE.md section 2): 34 of 4088 m=8 reversal-orbit families needed piecewise tree certificates split on block lengths.

A table-fed control closed the m=9 reversal 9..1 with zeros in gaps 0 and 4 by a staircase on axis 0: leaves u0 in [1,2] (origins (1,1)), [3,4] (origins (3,1)), u0 >= 5 (origins (5,1)), one word each.
Far out on an axis, refine its block (origin o_j > 1) so the stretched zero sits where words cross it less; near the corner, finite boxes tolerate slope above m-2.
hint.rule: Development and m=8 facts only; nothing from the validation or holdout sets.

campaign_config.kill_rule: After the four seed-1 runs: python -m integrations.bound_c3 kill-check --seed 1. For each arm, the accepted candidates (full development evaluation) among its first 15 distinct proposals are evaluated on validation; if none certifies more validation families than the c3 seed (157/165 offline), the runner stops before seed 2 (exit 3).
campaign_config.max_requests_note: Contact pool 360 (broker-config-c3.json contact_pool) = 12 runs x 30. The USD cap ($15 total, enforced by each run's broker at max_usd minus the other c3 ledgers) is the binding limit: at the projected $0.03-0.04 per call (REPORT-prep.md) 360 calls need about $11-14, so the last runs of seed 3 may stop early (BROKER_STOPPED). GEPA max_evals covers 30 + 31 * 36 = 1146 metric calls plus final checks.
campaign_config.note: Bound-m campaign 3 (TASK-c3.md): tree certificates (bound-eval-3, bound-contract-3). Every limit under engines applies to one run = one (arm, seed). Money, token, reasoning and timeout caps live in broker-config-c3.json. Development = campaign 1 frozen development.json by reference (hash in the c2 frozen/manifest.json); validation = c2 frozen/validation.json (m = 11, finalist selection and the kill check only); holdout = c2 frozen/holdout.json, never loaded by an engine, a prompt, the kill check or the seed check. Covered by the approval hash: python -m integrations.bound_c3 approval-hash.
campaign_config.order: Seeds interleaved: s1 gepa, sequential, adaevolve, evox; kill check; then s2; then s3 (run-campaign-c3.sh). A HALT file, a refused start, a FIRST_PROMPT_MISMATCH, 2 runs ending INCOMPLETE/BROKER_STOPPED, or the kill check stop the runner.
campaign_config.seed_note: Campaign-2 AdaEvolve-s2 finalist (autoresearch/bound-m-c2-260925/finalists/sources/adaevolve-s2.py) with a new module docstring, its code unchanged, plus a tree wrapper: the c2 word set as one unit-origin root leaf when a float LP passes criterion (7), else a table-free refined-origin staircase (origins min(l, 3) on one axis, lift-and-sweep words on the refined base, float LP for criterion (8)). Offline check: seed-eval/summary.json.
campaign_config.seed_semantics: SkyDiscover search.database.random_seed and GEPA EngineConfig.seed = run seed. The sequential control records the seed; the provider request carries no seed field, so its seeds differ only by sampling.

word_pool.note: No pool in campaign 3: tree leaves on refined bases do not pool across candidates.

prompt.system_message: Find a uniform construction of LRX sorting words whose length is provably bounded for a whole family of states. L rotates the vector left (first entry to the end), R rotates right, X swaps the first two entries. A family (a, S) is a label order a (a permutation of 1..m) and a set S of k nonempty gaps (gap g lies after the first g labels; g = 0 leading, g = m trailing); its states have u_j >= 1 zeros in the j-th gap of S; the unit base has one zero per gap. The candidate source must define certify(family) -> {'tree': NODE} (a plain {'words': [...]} is one leaf with unit origins). NODE is a split {'j': axis, 't': 1..12, 'le': NODE, 'ge': NODE} (u_j <= t goes to le, u_j >= t+1 to ge; the root box is [1, inf)^k) or a leaf {'words': [...], 'origins': [o_0..o_{k-1}], 'picks'?: [...]}: depth <= 6, <= 32 leaves, 1..32 words per leaf, <= 4000 letters per word, <= 256000 in all, o_j <= the leaf's lower corner l_j. A leaf's words are literal words on the REFINED base, where block j holds o_j zeros (picks[j], default 0, is the zero of block j that stretches); each must sort it to (1..m, 0..0) and never swap two zeros. The trusted evaluator prices each word with the research group's Lemma 1 (exact, any m): B = (number of X) + sum over segments of |net rotation|, beta_j = 2 * (X letters touching the stretched zero of block j) + sum over segments of |signed crossings of it| (a segment ends at every X), and cost C(u) = B + sum_j beta_j (u_j - o_j) on the leaf. Per leaf with box [l_j, h_j] an exact LP over your words checks criterion (8): some mixture has Cbar(l) - T(l) + sum over bounded j of max(0, betabar_j - s)(h_j - l_j) < 1 and betabar_j <= s on every unbounded axis, with s = m - 2 and T(l) = m(m+1)/2 + (sum_j l_j - 1)(m-2). The family is CERTIFIED when every leaf passes; that proves d(v) <= T_m(n) for every state of the family. Refining the stretched block (origin o_j > 1 on a leaf far out on axis j) lowers the slope a word needs there. Each family gets 3 s of CPU (module import 1 s). Score per m: percentage certified (the worst m counts twice), plus small terms for valid output and a small worst leaf gap. Development families are m = 9 and 10, reversal-type orders oversampled; the holdout has unseen families and an unseen m, so the program must work for any m with no tables: string constants over L/R/X of 24+ characters, literal containers with more than 64 elements and bytes constants over 256 bytes are rejected. Stdlib only, at most 64 KiB. Do not read files, the network, or environment variables. Misses prove nothing.

evaluator.contract: bound-contract-3: certify(family) -> {"tree": NODE, "note"?}; NODE = split {"j", "t", "le", "ge"} (u_j <= t | u_j >= t+1, 1 <= t <= 12) or leaf {"words", "origins"? (default 1s), "picks"? (default 0s), "weights"?}; root box [1,inf)^k; depth <= 6, <= 32 leaves, 1..32 words per leaf, <= 4000 letters per word, <= 256000 letters in all; o_j <= l_j. A plain {"words": [...]} is one root leaf with unit origins. Words are literal on the refined base (block j has o_j atoms), priced by Lemma 1 with formula (6), literal lift at z = 0, e_j, 2e_j, e_j+e_{j+1}, (1..1) above o and at box points l, l+e_j, l+2e_j for LP support words. Leaf passes iff the exact LP optimum of criterion (8) is < 1 with unbounded slopes <= m-2, T(l) = T_m(m+sum l); CERTIFIED iff every leaf passes; gap = max leaf gap; BOUNDARY iff not certified and gap 0. Sandbox, CPU limits, source guard, invalid gap 4000 and the combined score are bound-contract-2's.

per_family: worst leaf box, origins, T(l), lhs, slope excess

prompts.mechanism: Mechanism: each X that touches zero block j costs 2 on beta_j; each net rotation step across block j (per segment between X letters) costs 1.
prompts.objective: Improve this Python certify(family) program. It returns the campaign-2 lift-and-sweep word set as one unit-origin leaf when a float LP says criterion (7) holds; otherwise, axis by axis, it builds a staircase tree: at lower corner l on axis j the leaf uses origin o_j = min(l, 3), words from the same lift-and-sweep generator on the refined base priced with picks, and a float LP for criterion (8); the unbounded leaf [l, inf) closes the tree, else the widest passing [l, h] is kept and l = h + 1. Return the entire replacement Python source in one fenced code block, with no prose and no docstring longer than a few lines. Raise the number of certified families, first on the worst m: better words on refined bases (slopes beta_j at most m-2 on unbounded axes), better split axes, origins and picks, splits on two axes, and better use of the 3 s CPU. Most misses are reversal-orbit and near-reversal orders. Only development families are shown.
